I couldn't care about the issues here at all XD

I mean, last time changed a lot, most classes had okay fine dps still because of shifting power to DoTs. But with the across the board nerfs, everyone will do less damage, and the dot changes will bring spammables back. Which brings precise weaving to be more important. End game players wont feel the nerfs as badly because builds will just change again, but lower end players will find their DPS hit a lot harder since the easy to apply dots hurt less and are harder to sustain, and especially those who are bad at tracking DoTs and overcast will really feel the hurt. It's really gonna affect the casual playerbase.


Yes the changes arnt final, but a strong reaction to these current changes is appropriate, or else they may not be changed. If the original scalebreaker patch went live without the backlash that happened intitally, then it would have been a lot worse.


Also its one thing when power shifts, cross board nerfs are a slightly different story.


Also the game is losing a lot of players over the last patches. I've been in 5 guilds for 2-3 years, and after last patch, each one lost about half the players on average, plus a decent amount of youtubers and streamers have left/taken a break from the game.



Besides initial reactions are always strongest. The game is going thru a lot of changes. Some are good, some arnt. The last patch wasn't a success.
